objective: Increase qualified ERN discovery traffic while preserving source truth, privacy, lean-core limits and commercial-neutral ranking.

actions: Maintain indexable destination pages only while current/scheduled truth is valid.
Create demand-led editorial collection paths when multiple truthful current places support a real observed theme; never create thin pages for unresolved gaps.
Keep sitemap, hreflang, structured data, IndexNow and crawlable provider/source context current.
Preserve raw zero-result counts while triaging genuine destination gaps separately from typing fragments, venue/utility intent and terms that now resolve.
growthLoops.currentBatch: Search measurement now uses a longer 1500 ms settle window and schema-v2 read-only gap triage. Current Thailand research priorities include Chiang Mai, Dolphin Bay/Sam Roi Yot and Phuket; secondary Northern Thailand demand is tracked separately.

actions: Prefer destination and collection deep links over repeated homepage-only sharing.
Rotate places/countries so aggregate referral behavior can be compared.
Do not claim reach or causation from manual posting; use aggregate referrals and downstream exploration only.
Wait for genuine share/copy events before optimizing around visitor sharing.
Keep Open Live Source as the genuine provider handoff.
Only promote a source owner to outreach-ready after repeated value, verified ownership and a concrete visitor benefit.
Prefer reciprocal/co-marketing, visitor benefit or referral structures over paid ranking.
growthLoops.currentSignal: 82 aggregate external-source opens; evidence still too early for broad outreach.

actions: Protect fast search, related-place continuation and useful currentness labels.
Use planning actions only after a truthful current Earth view is selected.
Research repeated zero-result terms as product gaps rather than filling them with weak substitutes.
Preserve saved/recent/current-place utility to support repeat visits.
growthLoops.currentSignal: 338 place/window opens and 108 searches. Raw zero-result share remains material, but research prioritization now removes typing-progress and non-destination noise before source work.

protectedRules: Traffic goals never override source truth, currentness, permission or health.
Commercial value never affects Earth ranking or editorial prominence.
Do not publish weak substitutes merely to capture search traffic.
Do not store raw IP addresses or per-person histories.
Do not claim bookings, conversion, revenue, endorsement or causal attribution without direct evidence.
Do not exceed the 575 KB lean-core ceiling.
nextMeasurementQuestions: Does the longer search settle window reduce progressive typing-fragment zero results in future aggregate windows?
Which research-qualified destination gaps repeat after noise classification?
Do Thailand collection/deep-link entries generate qualified page, search, source-open or planning activity?
Which destination deep links attract referral traffic that continues into multiple place/window opens?
Which source owners accumulate repeated outbound value sufficient for human partnership review?

searchMeasurement.principle: Raw zero-result analytics remain historical evidence, but source-research priority must distinguish destination gaps from typing progress, venue/utility intent and already-resolved terms.
